A '''Cloak of Hate''' was a [[Cloak/Legends|garment]] imbued with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. It provided the wearer protection from extreme heat and cold, as well as from [[Force power/Legends|Force-based attacks]]. It also augmented the wearer's own stamina, agility and precision when attacking an opponent.
